title: Probability of exceeding the mean
statement: Let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube with Fourier degree at most $k$, where $k\in\mathbb N$, and suppose $f$ is nonconstant. For uniformly random $x$ in the cube, $\Pr[f(x)>\mathbb E f]\ge \frac14 e^{-2k}$.
hypotheses_covered: Real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube
